न: 1. न the dental nasal (found at the beginning of words and before or after dental consonants as well as between vowels; subject to conversion into ण, Pāṇ. viii, 4, 1-39).

2. न॑ ind. not, no, nor, neither, RV. (ना, x, 34, 8) &c. &c. (as well in simple negation as in wishing, requesting and commanding, except in prohibition before an Impv. or an augmentless aor. [cf. 1. मा]; in successive sentences or clauses either simply repeated e.g. Mn. iv, 34; or strengthened by another particle, esp. at the second place or further on in the sentence e.g. by उ [cf. नो], उत॑, अपि, चापि, वा, वापि or अथ वा, RV. i, 170, 1; 151, 9; Nal. iii, 24, &c.; it may even be replaced by च, वा, अपि च, अपि वा, &c. alone, as, Mn. ii, 98; Nal. i, 14, &c.; often joined with other particles, beside those mentioned above esp. with a following तु, त्व् एव, त्व् एव तु, चेद् q.v., खलु q.v., ह [cf. g. चादि and, Pāṇ. viii, 1, 31] &c.; before round or collective numbers and after any numeral in the instr. or abl. it expresses deficiency e.g. एकया न विंशति, not 20 by 1 i.e. 19 ŚBr.; पञ्चभिर् न चत्वारि शतानि, 395 ib.; with another न or an अ priv. it generally forms a strong affirmation [cf. Vām. v, 1, 9] e.g. नेयं न वक्ष्यति, she will most certainly declare, Śak. iii, 9; नादण्ड्यो ऽस्ति, he must certainly be punished, Mn. viii, 335; it may also, like अ, form compounds, Vām. v, 2, 13 [cf. below])
that not, lest, for fear lest (with Pot.), MBh.; R.; Daś. &c.

like, as, as it were (only in Veda and later artificial language, e.g. गौरो न तृषितः पिब, drink like [lit. ‘not’ i.e. ‘although not being’] a thirsty deer; in this sense it does not coalesce metrically with a following vowel).

न्याय्य: न्याय्य mf(आ)n. regular, customary, usual, correct, right, fit, proper (often with an infin. which then has a pass. sense), Lāṭy.; Mn.; MBh. &c.; also w.r. for न्याय.
न्याय्यदण्ड: न्याय्य—दण्ड mfn. punishing justly (-त्व n.), Gaut.
न्यालून: न्य्-आ-लून mfn. (√ लू) cut off, Hariv. (v.l. व्य्-आ-ल्°).
न्याविश्: न्य्-आ-√ विश् (only pf. -विविशुर्), to enter into (loc.), RV. x, 56, 4.
न्यावृत्: न्य्-आ-√ वृत् Caus. -वर्तयति, to make a person desist from (abl.), keep back, prevent, Kathās.
न्याव्यध्: न्य्-आ-√ व्यध् P. -विध्यति, to cause to burst forth, let loose, set free, MW.
न्यासद्: न्य्-आ-√ सद् P. -सीदति (pf. -ससाद ind.p. -सद्य), to sit down near or in or upon (loc. or acc.), RV.
न्याषत्त: न्य्-आ-षत्त mfn. (or -आ॑-नि॑-ष्°), sitting down or on, seated on
न्युच्: न्य्-√ उच् P. -उच्यति (pf. -उवोच), to delight or take pleasure in (acc. or loc.), RV.; to like to stay in or with (loc.), AV.
न्योक: न्य्-ओक a mfn. (prob.) = next, Kāś. on Pāṇ. vii, 3, 64.
न्योकस्: न्य्-°ओकस् mfn. belonging to home, domestic, wont, comfortable, RV.; AitBr.
न्योचनी: न्य्-°ओचनी f. (prob.) a kind of woman's ornament (Sāy. ‘female slave’), RV. x, 85, 6.
न्योचर: न्य्-°ओचर॑ mfn. (prob.) belonging to or fit for a place, AV. v, 22, 5.
न्युद्: न्य्-√ उद् or उन्द् (only p. Ā. -उन्दमान), to dip, sprinkle, ŚāṅkhBr.
न्युन्द्: न्य्-√ उद् or उन्द् (only p. Ā. -उन्दमान), to dip, sprinkle, ŚāṅkhBr.
न्युत्त: न्य्-°उत्त mfn. dipped in, sprinkled with (loc.), ŚBr.
न्युब्ज्: न्य्-√ उब्ज् P. -उब्जति, to bend or press or throw upside down, upset, overthrow, SV.; AV.; Br.
न्युब्ज: न्युब्ज mfn. turned or bent downwards, lying with the face downwards, looking downwards, KātyŚr.; MBh.; Hariv.; Suśr.
hump-backed, crooked-backed (as the result of disease cf. Pāṇ. vii, 3, 61), L.
न्युब्ज m. N. of the Nyag-rodha tree in Kuru-kṣetra, AitBr.
न्युब्ज n. the fruit of the Averrhoa Carambola, L.
न्युब्ज m. or n. = श्राद्धादि-पात्र-भेद, दर्भमयश्रुच्, or कुश-श्रुच्, L.
न्युब्जखड्ग: न्युब्ज—खड्ग m. a crooked sword, a sabre, L.
न्युब्जक: न्य्-°उब्जक mf(इका)n. = next Comm. on TāṇḍBr.
न्युभ्: न्य्-√ उभ् P. -उभ्नाति (impf. -औभ्नात्), to keep down or together, RV. iv, 19, 4.
न्युष्: न्य्-√ उष् P. -ओषति (Impv. -ओषतात्), to burn down, consume or destroy utterly, RV.; AV.
न्यूङ्ख: न्यूङ्ख m. the insertion of the sound ओ (in different places with difference of quantity and accentuation) in the recitation of hymns, Br.; ŚrS. &c. (cf. Pāṇ. i, 2, 34 Sch.)
न्यूङ्खम्: न्यूङ्खम् ind. with the Nyūṅkha, ŚāṅkhŚr.
न्यूङ्खनीय: न्यूङ्खनीय mfn. to be inserted, ŚāṅkhŚr.
न्यूङ्खय: न्यूङ्खय Nom. P. °यति, to insert the Nyūṅkha, Br.; ŚrS.;  Ā. (न्यू॑ङ्खयते) to growl (as a hungry animal), RV. x, 94, 3.
न्यून: न्य्-ऊ॑न mf(आ)n. (fr. नि with ऊन) less, diminished, defective, deficient (opp. to अति-रिक्त, अधिक, पूर्ण), destitute or deprived of (instr. or comp.), inferior to (abl.), Br.; GṛŚrS.; MBh.; Suśr. &c.
(with पादैः) having a defect in the feet, BhP.
low, vile, base, mean, MBh.; Var.; Pur.
न्य्-ऊ॑न n. euphem. = vulva, TS.; ŚBr.
want or omission of one of the 5 members in a Nyāya argument, Nyāyas.
न्यूनतर: न्य्-ऊ॑न—तर mfn. falling below a standard, Divyâv.
न्यूनपञ्चाशद्भाव: न्य्-ऊ॑न—पञ्चाशद्-भाव m. ‘having 49 (not full 50) properties of human nature’, an idiot, L.
न्यूनपदत्व: न्य्-ऊ॑न—पद°त्व n. want of one word in a sentence, Sāh.
न्यूनाक्षर: न्यूनाक्षर॑ mf(आ)n. defective in letters or syllables, ŚBr.
न्यूनाङ्ग: न्यूनाङ्ग mf(आ)n. defective in a limb or organ, maimed, mutilated, imperfect, W.
न्यूनाधिक: न्यूनाधिक mfn. less or more, unequal
न्यूनाधिकविभक्त: न्यूनाधिक—विभक्त mfn. one who has received too little or too much at the division of an inheritance, Yājñ.
न्यूनाधिकाङ्ग: न्यूनाधिकाङ्ग mfn. having less or more limbs or organs (than necessary), Suśr.
न्यूनाधिक्य: न्यूनाधिक्य n. want or surplus (e.g. of an organ), Hcat.
न्यूनेन्द्रिय: न्यूनेन्द्रिय mfn. wanting some organ or sense, deficient, imperfect (as blind, deaf &c.), W.
न्यूनय: न्यूनय Nom. P. °यति, to lessen, diminish, Bhaṭṭ. Sch.
न्यूनीकृ: न्यूनी—√ कृ to make less, lessen, diminish, Bhaṭṭ. Sch.
न्यूनीभाव: न्यूनी—भाव m. state of deficiency, incompleteness, L.
न्यूह्: न्य्-√ ऊह् a Ā. -ऊहते, to push in for one's self, drive into one's own stable, TāṇḍBr.
न्य्-√ ऊह् b Ā. -ओहते, to heed or to appear, RV. v, 52, 11.
न्यृ: न्य्-√ ऋ P. -ऋण्वति, to lay down, put or place in (loc.), RV. : Caus. -अर्पयति, to throw down, ib.; AV.
न्यृञ्ज्: न्य्-√ ऋञ्ज् Ā. -ऋञ्जते, to reach, attain, overpower, subdue, RV.
न्यृष्: न्य्-√ ऋष् P. -ऋषति, to push or stuff into (acc.), cover, fill, RV.; ŚBr.
न्यृष्ट: न्य्-°ऋष्ट mfn. filled or endowed with (instr.), RV.
न्ये: न्ये (न्य्-आ-√ इ, only ind.p. -एत्य), to fall into (acc.), BṛĀrUp.
न्येज्: न्य्-√ एज् P. -एजति tremble, Kir. xv, 22.
न्येर्: न्येर् (न्य्-अ-√ ईर्, only pf. Ā. न्येरिरे॑), to direct or address (a wish or desire) to (loc.), R.; to appoint as (acc.), ib. (cf. नीर्).
न्वै: न्वै॑ ind. (for नु॑-वै॑) indeed, certainly, Br. (cf. Pāṇ. vi, 1, 94, Vārtt. 1, Pat.)
